title: On Relaxing the rules for the youngest boys
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：relax　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relax 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the keeper ① relaxed the rules for the youngest boys in silence, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② relaxes the rules for the youngest boys twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ relax the rules for the youngest boys at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ relaxed the rules for the youngest boys before — a line in the calendar for January 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Relaxing the rules for the youngest boys in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ relax after the harvest was in twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Relax after the harvest was in at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ relaxes after the harvest was in in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ relaxed the rules for the youngest boys again when nobody else would.

⑩ To relax the rules for the youngest boys, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody relaxes the rules for the youngest boys twice over again and somebody must relax the rules for the youngest boys in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 放松（一般过去式 relaxed the rules for the youngest boys：1988 年守夜人头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 放松（一般现在 relaxes the rules for the youngest boys：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 放松（不定式 to relax the rules for the youngest boys：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 放松（过去完成时 had relaxed the rules for the youngest boys：1982 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 放松（动名词 relaxing the rules for the youngest boys 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 松懈（relax after the harvest was in：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去松懈收完庄稼后就松懈下来）
G. v. 松懈（relax after the harvest was in：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 放松（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 relaxes after the harvest was in，而母亲又一次 relaxed the rules for the youngest boys）

relax 意为“放松”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯放松给最小的那些孩子放宽规矩”，此处为不定式 to relax the rules for the youngest boys。
relax 意为“放松”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人放松过，故用过去完成时 had relaxed。

relax 意为“放松”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例松懈收完庄稼后就松懈下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 relaxes。

relax 意为“放松”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要放松给最小的那些孩子放宽规矩，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 relax 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the keeper relaxed the rules for the youngest boys in silence, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper relaxes the rules for the youngest boys twice over whenever the tower asks.
Relaxing the rules for the youngest boys in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever relax after the harvest was in twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower relaxes after the harvest was in in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother relaxed the rules for the youngest boys again, and the tower remembered that half.
